policy: Use original WebUAV3M-source videos from the official AirScape training split. Group by source sequence (remove leading dataset index and trailing clip index); exclude every official-test source sequence; shuffle groups with seed0, first256 validation and next1536 training; choose one random clip per group. Exclude entire source sequences containing a file duplicated in the candidate pool or official test metadata. Only publicly present files are eligible. Native text unchanged.
scope: Video-intention retrieval adaptation of AirScape, WebUAV3M source subset. Not reproduction of the original world-model benchmark. One native text per video; same eight-frame mean pooling as CapERA cannot represent temporal ordering.
caption_source: Native text remains in the official parquet; no captions redistributed here.
